title: Meta releases open-weight Muse Glimmer, will open Muse Spark 1.2
summary: Meta released a ~30B open model for local agents and said it will open its frontier Muse Spark 1.2 weights; Zuckerberg urged the US to remove barriers to open AI and pledged $1B for data-center community concerns.
reason: Strong open-weights push from a major lab.

title: Nvidia and Wall Street firms line up ~$500B for AI infrastructure
summary: Nvidia partnered with BlackRock, Goldman Sachs, KKR, Blackstone and others to raise about $500 billion for data centers and fabs.
reason: Huge capital pool for compute concentrated around Nvidia.

title: South Australia launches royal commission into AI
summary: South Australia announced a royal commission on artificial intelligence; NSW floated ending unsupervised take-home assessments over generative AI.

title: Unitree files for ~$904M Shanghai IPO
summary: Hangzhou robot maker Unitree is seeking about 6.1 billion yuan in a Shanghai listing, with over 40% of 2025 revenue from overseas.

title: South Korea sets up 5 trillion won chip supply-chain fund; TSMC July sales up 45%
summary: Seoul launched a ~$3.5B fund for chip materials, equipment and fabless design; TSMC reported July revenue up about 45% and raised its outlook on AI demand.
reason: Asian chip capacity expanding for AI.
